description: This file defines template utilities for obtaining compile-time type and value names using compiler-specific function signatures, primarily for debugging or reflection purposes.

classes.name: CompileTimeTypeName
classes.description: Template struct that captures the type name at compile time using __PRETTY_FUNCTION__.

classes.name: CompileTimeValueName
classes.description: Template struct that captures the value name at compile time using __PRETTY_FUNCTION__.

methods.name: ExtractName
methods.description: Function that extracts a clean type or value name from the __PRETTY_FUNCTION__ string.

methods.name: TypeName
methods.description: Template function that returns the name of a type as a string_view.

methods.name: ValueName
methods.description: Template function that returns the name of a value as a string_view.
